commands.description: Use when about to claim work is complete, fixed, or passing, before committing or creating PRs - requires running verification commands and confirming output before making any success claims; evidence before assertions always
commands.name: skill:verification-before-completion

commands.description: Stop. That last message did not land: re-pitch it.
commands.name: skill:wait-what

commands.description: Plan a huge chunk of work (more than one agent session can hold) as a shared map of decision tickets on your issue tracker, and resolve them one at a time until the way to the destination is clear.
commands.name: skill:wayfinder

commands.description: Generate an interactive bash wizard that walks a human through steps only they can perform. Use when provisioning infrastructure, setting up credentials or CI secrets, walking an unfamiliar third-party dashboard, or running a one-off migration or cutover. Don't invoke this for steps the agent can perform itself.
commands.name: skill:wizard

commands.description: How to write modern Swift well — modeling with value types, Swift 6 data-race safety and approachable concurrency (@concurrent, main-actor-by-default, actors, task groups), protocols and generics (some vs any), API design, performance and ARC, Swift Testing, macros, and the modern language features agents don't know about yet. Use when writing, reviewing, or migrating Swift, or when a concurrency error, a hang, a data race, a retain cycle, or a performance problem needs fixing.
commands.name: skill:write-swift

commands.description: Writing, exploit; assemble raw material into a journey of beats, grounding each term before a beat leans on it.
commands.name: skill:writing-beats

commands.description: Writing documents for agents. Use when creating or editing skills, or modifying AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
commands.name: skill:writing-for-agents

commands.description: Writing, explore: mine raw fragments, no structure yet.
commands.name: skill:writing-fragments

commands.description: Use when you have a spec or requirements for a multi-step task, before touching code
commands.name: skill:writing-plans

commands.description: Writing, exploit: shape raw material into an article, paragraph by paragraph.
commands.name: skill:writing-shape

commands.description: Use when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment
commands.name: skill:writing-skills

commands.description: Toggle builtin autoresearch mode, or pass off / clear, or a goal message.
commands.name: autoresearch

commands.description: Generate a prompt to iterate on CI failures until the branch is green
commands.name: green

commands.description: Launch interactive code review
commands.name: review

commands.description: Annotate a diff or text from a file, prompt, latest reply, or session
commands.name: annotate

commands.description: Generate AGENTS.md for current codebase
commands.name: init
